arxiv-2103-06533.title: Triple-cooperative Video Shadow Detection
arxiv-2103-06533.creator: Zhihao Chen 1∗, Liang Wan 1, Lei Zhu 2, Jia Shen 1, Huazhu Fu 3, Wennan Liu 4, Jing Qin 5 1 College of Intelligence and Computing, Tianjin University 2 Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics, University of Cambridge 3 Inception Institute of Artificial Intelligence, UAE 4 Academy o
arxiv-2103-06533.description: Abstract Shadow detection in a single image has received significant research interests in recent years. However, much fewer works have been explored in shadow detection over dynamic scenes. The bottleneck is the lack of a well-established dataset with high-quality annotations for video shadow detection.

arxiv-2111-09223.title: MOCCA-SURVEY Database II – Properties of Intermediate Mass Black Holes escaping from star clusters 2021 MOCCA-SURVEY Database II – Properties of Intermediate Mass Black Holes escaping from star clusters – References
arxiv-2111-09223.creator: Konrad Maliszewski, Mirek Giersz, Dorota Gondek-Rosińska, Abbas Askar, Arkadiusz Hypki
arxiv-2111-09223.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Konrad Maliszewski, Mirek Giersz, Dorota Gondek-Rosińska, Abbas Askar, Arkadiusz Hypki. In this work we investigate properties of intermediate-mass black holes (IMBHs) that escape from star clusters due to dynamical interactions. The studied models were simulated as part of the preliminary second survey carried out using the MOCCA code (MOCCA-SURVEY Database II), which is based on the Monte Carlo N -body method and does not include gravitational wave recoil kick prescriptions of the binary black hole merger product.

arxiv-2203-09870.title: Open-source finite volume solvers for multiphase (n-phase) flows involving either Newtonian or non-Newtonian complex fluids Journal: Computers and Fluids
arxiv-2203-09870.creator: Chris Dritselis, George Karapetsas
arxiv-2203-09870.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Chris Dritselis, George Karapetsas. Two new control volume solvers multiFluidInterFoam and rheoMultiFluidInterFoam are presented for the simulation of Newtonian and non-Newtonian n-phase flows ( n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 ), respectively, fully accounting for interfacial tension and contact-angle effects for each phase. The multiFluidInterFoam solver modifies certain crucial aspects of the regular multiphaseInterFoam solver provided by OpenFOAM for Newtonian flows, improving its efficiency and robustness, but most importantly improving considerably its accuracy for surface tension driven flows.

arxiv-2210-09405.title: Towards Generating Adversarial Examples on Mixed-type Data
arxiv-2210-09405.creator: Han Xu, Zhimeng Jiang, Menghai Pan, Huiyuan Chen, Xiaoting Li, Mahashweta Das, Hao Yang
arxiv-2210-09405.description: Abstract The existence of adversarial attacks (or adversarial examples) brings huge concern about the machine learning (ML) model’s safety issues. For many safety-critical ML tasks, such as financial forecasting, fraudulent detection, and anomaly detection, the data samples are usually mixed-type, which contain plenty of numerical and categorical features at the same time.

arxiv-2306-11970.title: RSMT: Real-time Stylized Motion Transition for Characters Conference: Special Interest Group on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques Conference Conference Proceedings; August 6–10, 2023; Los Angeles, CA, USA Special Interest Group on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques Conference Co
arxiv-2306-11970.creator: Xiangjun Tang, Linjun Wu, He Wang, Bo Hu, Xu Gong, Yuchen Liao, Songnan Li, Qilong Kou, Xiaogang Jin
arxiv-2306-11970.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xiangjun Tang, Linjun Wu, He Wang, Bo Hu, Xu Gong, Yuchen Liao, Songnan Li, Qilong Kou, Xiaogang Jin. Styled online in-between motion generation has important application scenarios in computer animation and games. Its core challenge lies in the need to satisfy four critical requirements simultaneously: generation speed, motion quality, style diversity, and synthesis controllability.

arxiv-2310-18994.title: Investigation of correlation effects in FeSe superconductor by LDA+U method
arxiv-2310-18994.creator: H. Lohani, P. Mishra, B. R. Sekhar
arxiv-2310-18994.description: Abstract Correlation effects are observed strong in Iron chalcogenides superconductors by experimental and theoretical investigations. We present a comparative study of the influence of Coulomb interaction and Hund’s coupling in the electronic structure of FeSe and FeTe. The calculation is based on density functional theory (DFT) with local density approximation(LDA+U) framework employed in TB-LMTO ASA code.

arxiv-2311-13653.title: On the Galactic radio signal from stimulated decay of axion dark matter
arxiv-2311-13653.creator: P. S. Bhupal Dev, Francesc Ferrer, Takuya Okawa
arxiv-2311-13653.description: Abstract We study the full-sky distribution of the radio emission from the stimulated decay of axions which are assumed to compose the dark matter in the Galaxy. Besides the constant extragalactic and CMB components, the decays are stimulated by a Galactic radio emission with a spatial distribution that we empirically determine from observations.

arxiv-2402-02906.title: ViewFusion: Learning Composable Diffusion Models for Novel View Synthesis Thanks: Work done at Aalto University.
arxiv-2402-02906.creator: Bernard Spiegl bernard.spiegl@proton.me
arxiv-2402-02906.description: Abstract Deep learning is providing a wealth of new approaches to the problem of novel view synthesis, from Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) based approaches to end-to-end style architectures. Each approach offers specific strengths but also comes with limitations in their applicability. This work introduces ViewFusion , an end-to-end generative approach to novel view synthesis with unparalleled flexibility.

arxiv-2402-10633.title: Crossing number of graphs and Δ ​ 𝖸 \mathsf{\Delta Y} -move
arxiv-2402-10633.creator: Youngsik Huh, Ryo Nikkuni
arxiv-2402-10633.description: Abstract . The crossing number of a graph is the minimum number of double points over all generic immersions of the graph into the plane. In this paper we investigate the behavior of crossing number under a graph transformation, called Δ ​ 𝖸 \mathsf{\Delta Y} -move, on the complete graph K n K_{n} .

arxiv-2503-22243.title: QCD thermodynamics with dynamical chiral fermions
arxiv-2503-22243.creator: K.K. Szabo
arxiv-2503-22243.description: Abstract We discuss properties of thermal Quantum Chromodynamics obtained by means of lattice simulations with overlap fermions. This fermion discretisation preserves chiral symmetry at finite lattice spacing. We present details of the formulation and results for the chiral observables. We determine the topological susceptibility from simulations at fixed global topological charge based on the slab method.

arxiv-2504-11152.title: The imprints of QCD cascades in hadron multiplicity distribution
arxiv-2504-11152.creator: Maciej Rybczyński, Zbigniew Włodarczyk
arxiv-2504-11152.description: Abstract The relation between parton and hadron multiplicity distributions is discussed. To obtain parton multiplicity distribution we propose decomposition of the multiplicity distributions of final state hadrons. Such procedure offers hope for experimental testing of physical probes of quantum complexity.

arxiv-2508-02596.title: High risk aversion Merton’s problem without transversality conditions
arxiv-2508-02596.creator: Enrico Biffis Cristina Di Girolami Salvatore Federico Fausto Gozzi
arxiv-2508-02596.description: Abstract Abstract This paper revisits the classical Merton portfolio choice problem over infinite horizon for high risk aversion, addressing technical challenges related to establishing the existence and identification of optimal strategies. Traditional methods rely on perturbation arguments and/or impose restrictive conditions, such as large discount rates and/or bounded strategies, to ensure well-posedness.

pmc-10499030.title: Cardiorespiratory physiology and swimming capacity of Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) at cold temperatures
pmc-10499030.creator: Emma S Porter, A Kurt Gamperl
pmc-10499030.description: We investigated how acclimation to 8, 4 and 1°C, and acute cooling from 8 to 1°C, affected the Atlantic salmon's aerobic and anaerobic metabolism, and cardiac function, during a critical swim speed (Ucrit) test. This study revealed several interesting temperature-dependent effects.

pmc-11314767.title: Software-Defined-Networking-Based One-versus-Rest Strategy for Detecting and Mitigating Distributed Denial-of-Service Attacks in Smart Home Internet of Things Devices
pmc-11314767.creator: Neder Karmous, Mohamed Ould-Elhassen Aoueileyine, Manel Abdelkader, Lamia Romdhani, Neji Youssef
pmc-11314767.description: The number of connected devices or Internet of Things (IoT) devices has rapidly increased. According to the latest available statistics, in 2023, there were approximately 17.2 billion connected IoT devices; this is expected to reach 25.4 billion IoT devices by 2030 and grow year over year for the foreseeable future.

pmc-11476137.title: Report of incomplete intestinal obstruction in an adult patient with Down Syndrome: A literature review
pmc-11476137.creator: Ning Yang
pmc-11476137.description: We report a case of incomplete intestinal obstruction in a 29-year-old adult male with Down syndrome in The First Affiliated Hospital, Hebei Medical University from January 2023 to July 2023 the patient had been experiencing intermittent abdominal distension and reduced bowel movements and gas for a period of two years. Physical examination revealed tenderness in the left lower abdomen.

pmc-11506418.title: How Does Understanding of Social Situations and Other’s Intention Contribute to Idiom and Irony Comprehension in Autism Spectrum Disorder?
pmc-11506418.creator: Nira Mashal, Naama Lellouche
pmc-11506418.description: Background/Objectives: Figurative language is a central tool for enriching spoken and written languages, and it is important for building social relationships. Difficulties in figurative language understanding may impair social adjustment. Some studies have found more gaps in the understanding of irony and idioms among children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) compared to those of their peers with typical development (TD).

pmc-11615187.title: Neural mechanisms of adaptive behavior: Dissociating local cortical modulations and interregional communication patterns
pmc-11615187.creator: Nasibeh Talebi, Astrid Prochnow, Christian Frings, Alexander Münchau, Moritz Mückschel, Christian Beste
pmc-11615187.description: SummaryAdaptive behavior is based on flexibly managing and integrating perceptual and motor processes, and the reconfiguration thereof. Such adaptive behavior is also relevant during inhibitory control. Although research has demonstrated local activity modulations in theta and alpha frequency bands during behavioral adaptation, the communication of brain regions is insufficiently studied.

pmc-11674083.title: Comparison of Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Pyroptosis Induced by Pathogenic Calcium Oxalate Monohydrate and Physiologic Calcium Oxalate Dihydrate Crystals in HK-2 Cells: Insights into Kidney Stone Formation
pmc-11674083.creator: Wei-Jian Nong, Xin-Yi Tong, Jian-Ming Ouyang, Alexander Wree
pmc-11674083.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS) can activate pyroptosis through CHOP and TXNIP; however, the correlation between this process and the formation of kidney stones has not been reported. The purpose is to investigate the effects of calcium oxalate monohydrate (COM) and calcium oxalate dihydrate (COD) on ERS and pyroptosis in HK-2 cells and to explore the formation mechanism of calcium oxalate stones. HK-2 cells were injured by 3 μm COM and COD.

pmc-12518450.title: Circular RNAs orchestrating breast cancer hallmarks: bridging tumor biology and therapy resistance
pmc-12518450.creator: Abdelhamid M. Abdelhamid, Mai Ahmed Shafei, Mariam Gamaleldin, Alaa Bassam Heikal, Wesam H. Khidr, Nabil Hazza Al-Saadi, Ganna Magdy Kandil, Mahmoud M. Omarn, Maha Alhelf
pmc-12518450.description: Breast cancer (BC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women worldwide, with treatment resistance posing a significant clinical challenge. Circular RNAs (circRNAs), a class of non-coding RNAs, have gained increasing attention as key regulators of gene expression, influencing BC pathogenesis, progression, and therapeutic response.

pmc-13025500.title: Associations Between 24 H Movement Behaviors and Body Weight in Postpartum Women: An Isotemporal Substitution Model Approach
pmc-13025500.creator: Erin E. Kishman, Shawn D. Youngstedt, Xuewen Wang
pmc-13025500.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: There are limited data on the dynamic changes in daily composition of movement behaviors (sleep; moderate-to-vigorous physical activity, MVPA; light physical activity, LPA; and sedentary time, SED) and their associations with body weight in postpartum women. The purpose of this study was to examine associations of reallocating time in one behavior to another with body weight, at different times in the first year postpartum. Methods: The study included 86 women who delivered a singleton infant at ≥37 weeks gestation.

pmc-13459378.title: Clinical outcomes and patient-reported joint noise after total knee arthroplasty using saddle-shaped rotating-platform and bi-cruciate-stabilized implant-surgical systems: a propensity score-matched cohort study
pmc-13459378.creator: Masafumi Itoh, Umito Kuwashima, Junya Itou, Ken Okazaki
pmc-13459378.description: BackgroundDifferent posterior cruciate ligament-sacrificing total knee arthroplasty (TKA) systems use distinct stabilization concepts, but their comparative clinical outcomes, including joint noise and knee flexion, remain unclear. We aimed to compare clinical outcomes, including noise and flexion, between the saddle-shaped rotating platform (ROCC) and bi-cruciate-stabilized (BCS) TKA.

pmc-13572846.description: This research note, informed by qualitative fieldwork with resource harvesters in Nova Scotia, explores the effect of economic change and ecological crisis, the outcomes of rural development strategies, and demographic shifts that have shaped the province's rural areas in recent years.

pmc-13581691.title: Perioperative CALLY dynamics after curative gastrectomy for gastric adenocarcinoma: associations with nodal tumor burden, textbook surgical outcome, and disease-free survival
pmc-13581691.creator: Adem Ozcan, Gizem Gunes
pmc-13581691.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe C-reactive protein–albumin–lymphocyte index (CALLY) integrates inflammation, nutrition, and cellular immunity. Its relationships with nodal tumor burden and within-patient postoperative recovery after gastrectomy remain unclear.MethodsThis retrospective cohort included 188 patients undergoing R0 gastrectomy for non-metastatic gastric adenocarcinoma. Preoperative CALLY was evaluated in relation to metastatic lymph node count, lymph node ratio (LNR), log odds of positive lymph nodes (LODDS), and pN status.

uslaw-usc-t42-s5302.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 69 (Community Development). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions As used in this chapter— (1) The term “unit of general local government” means any city, county, town, township, parish, village, or other general purpose political subdivision of a State; Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, the Virgin Islands, and American Samoa.
